name: Brad Baylor
profileSummary: Brad Baylor is an American professional wrestler. He performs on the independent circuit and is also signed to WWE, where he is part of the WWE ID program and performs on the NXT brand. Baylor is in a tag team with Ricky Smokes as Swipe Right, where they are also members of The Vanity Project. Baylor and Smokes are the current NXT Tag Team Champions in their first reign as a team and individually.
